notes: Exact unit cases pin all eight C caster/victim output literals, including LFCR order, and the NPC control pins C's bit-16 Lycanthropy action flag and silent Vampirism return (R1/R2/R3/R5e/R5h).
After lycanthropy sets the werewolf flag, the fixed moon gate reaches the successful transform line (R1/R2/R5e/R5h).

At SUN_DARK a werewolf who already carries AFF_WEREWOLF is refused with "You can't change back until morning!"; the same scenario transforms first, so the arm is reached through the real state machine.
At SUN_DARK an affected vampire is refused with "You can't change back until morning!"; the scenario transforms once first, reaching the arm through AFF_VAMPIRE.

Needs SUN_DARK plus time_info.day in 1..5. The harness fixed-time pin derives day and hour from the same timestamp, and the pinned dates that land on a low day land at a SUN_LIGHT hour (day 5 -> 6am), so the arm cannot be posed; no fixture sets the mud date separately.

The werewolf and vampire revert arms need AFF_WEREWOLF/AFF_VAMPIRE live at a SUN_LIGHT boot; the affect can only be set by transforming at night, and the pinned clock never advances to morning in one run. No fixture sets a player affect.
